data.content_ref: inline:The preemptive isolation of failure vectors (SRC_002) shares mechanism with 'Global Circuit Breaking' (SRC_003), both relying on the assumption that the system can distinguish a nascent failure from normal volatility; this is refuted if the 'Entropy of Configuration' (SCR_007) in a decentralized system provides a more robust noise-floor that prevents the 'Herding Effect' from occurring in the first place.
